title: Expose HDR passes in the native performance CSV
body: VulkanGraphApplication.cpp hand-enumerates performance loggers and omitted exposure_meter, exposure_reduce, and exposure_tonemap, so the native CSV could not locate the dispatched 1.1 ms cost. I added those three graph-node loggers manually. Derive CSV pass columns from the render graph or a shared pass registry so new passes become measurable automatically.

title: Keep silent native builds alive under the box queue
body: The queued native full build launched run_build_with_summary.ps1, which redirects Ninja output to a file and only prints after completion. The box idle watchdog killed the outer job after 199 seconds while the Windows build continued as a child. I switched to scoped CMake output through the queue. Add a live heartbeat or queue-aware process supervision to the native helper.

title: Make the native build entry point use the installed Visual Studio toolchain
body: After build.bat provision installed Ninja and detected Visual Studio 2022, build.bat all vixen-ninja still reported no VS installation with the C++ x64 toolchain. I had to call the installed vcvars64.bat directly before running the documented native CMake helper. Keep the selected VS installation in the native build setup.

title: Resolve the Yeroket kernel root in native WSL-backed checkouts
body: Native CMake configure defaulted YEROKET_ROOT to /Github/Yeroket-Fantasy and failed before generation because that path did not exist from Windows. I supplied //wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy and a worktree-local kernel cache in CMakeUserPresets.json. Detect or document the Windows-visible provider root automatically.

title: Provision the assigned native checkout with the lane base
body: The assigned /mnt/c/vixen-native/hdrmeter path was absent, so I had to create the Windows-native checkout manually with git worktree add --detach at the recorded lane base before native verification. Provision the native mirror as part of lane setup.

title: Keep native build helper parameters compatible across wave bases
body: The first native build helper invocation passed -StreamProgress, which the lane-base run_build_with_summary.ps1 did not define, and exited before CMake started. Removing that helper-only argument was required to recover. Call only parameters supported by the checked-out helper or feature-detect them.

title: Quote Windows paths in queued native build invocations
body: The first queued cmd.exe invocation used an unquoted C:\ path from a WSL UNC working directory; cmd reported unsupported UNC cwd and stripped backslashes from the script path before exit 1. Setting a drive working directory and quoting the C:\ batch path recovered it. Provide a standard queued Windows command wrapper for WSL.

title: Ignore DrvFS executable-bit noise in Windows native worktrees
body: The native checkout on /mnt/c inherits core.filemode=true from the shared git config; git status marked 2683 tracked files as mode-changed even though git hash-object matched HEAD and git -c core.filemode=false reduced status to real content changes. Configure filemode=false per native worktree without changing other lanes.

title: Preserve canonical line endings in generated native outputs
body: The base recipe_simd_check reported RecipeSimd.g.hpp stale, while recipe_simd_regen reported zero added or removed lines and git hash-object matched the base blob. The generated file was normalized to LF on the Windows-mounted checkout, so check and regen disagreed over line endings. Make the generator and check compare the canonical text form.

title: Enable MSVC extended aligned storage in the native preset
body: A fresh VixenApp target build fails at BodyOctreeSceneNode.cpp because MSVC rejects std::aligned_storage<144,16> unless _ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE is defined. I added /D_ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE to the local native CMake preset, following the compiler diagnostic. Put the intentional extended-alignment opt-in in the supported Windows preset or target configuration.

title: Preserve MSVC exception flags when adding native CXX options
body: The local preset override CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=/D_ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE replaced CMake's default /EHsc option. The scoped retry then failed fresh SVO objects with C4530 under /W4 /WX. I identified the cause and am restoring default flags; append compiler definitions without discarding exception settings or express them through target compile definitions.

title: Keep the exposure mirror assertions live in Release builds
body: test_exposure_meter_mirror.cpp uses assert(), but the CMake target has no UNDEBUG option and the native Release preset defines NDEBUG. The requested mirror witness would compile its core assertions away. Preserve assertions for this target in Release or use checks that do not depend on NDEBUG.

title: Run native CMake presets from the VIXEN source directory
body: The local reset configure invoked cmake --preset hdrmeter-native from the repository root, where no CMakePresets.json exists, and exited before configuration. The preset is under VIXEN/. Use the VIXEN source directory consistently or pass an explicit source directory in the native wrapper.

title: Make direct CMake inherit the provisioned Vulkan SDK pin
body: On the fresh Windows checkout, cmake --preset hdrmeter-native failed with Vulkan SDK 1.4.350.0 missing even though build.bat provision found the installed SDK and wrote VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain/vulkan-sdk-root.txt. Direct CMake needed an extra set /p VULKAN_SDK step in a local batch file. Teach the native configure entry point to consume the provisioned pin automatically.

title: Scope native Git trust to the WSL kernel provider root
body: A fresh Windows-side CMake configure failed when Git inspected the WSL-backed Yeroket provider root at //wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy, reporting dubious ownership. A process-scoped GIT_CONFIG_COUNT safe.directory entry for that exact root made git rev-parse succeed without editing global config. Include provider roots in the native launcher's scoped trust list.

title: Stage TBB for native lookdev capture CTest
body: The queued native Application.LookdevCapture CTest failed before rendering with exit 0xc0000135. vixen_lookdev_capture.exe imports tbb12.dll; the DLL is in build/hdrmeter-native/msvc_19.44_cxx_64_md_release, but that directory was not on the CTest process PATH. Adding that directory to PATH is the local recovery. Add the same post-build TBB staging used by other native tests to vixen_lookdev_capture.

title: Keep native CTest captures alive under the box idle watchdog
body: The queued native Application.LookdevCapture CTest launched the Windows capture process and wrote both sets of PNGs, but the WSL queue saw no CPU or output for 200 seconds and cancelled it with exit 75, leaving the Windows child alive. Running the capture under the gpu resource with a queue-visible 20-second text heartbeat keeps the witness exclusive and observable. Teach the box monitor to track Windows child progress or provide heartbeat support for native tests.

title: Expose Vulkan buffer allocation failure stages in native captures
body: The queued native midday 500 capture on merged base 834f7856 failed before rendering with only VoxelGridNode's generic 'Failed to create ray trace buffer (binding 4)' message. RayTraceBuffer::Create returned false without identifying whether buffer creation, memory-type selection, allocation, or binding failed; temporary result-code diagnostics let the unchanged capture retry pass but the original failure did not recur. Keep stage/result and eligible memory-type diagnostics at this boundary so native render failures are actionable without ad hoc instrumentation.

title: Provide a supported look-dev PNG contact sheet composer
body: The requested four-angle look-dev sheets had no installed image montage tool in WSL (no ImageMagick, ffmpeg, or Pillow), so I wrote a temporary Node PNG decoder/compositor under the native checkout's .tmp directory to assemble captures without resizing or retouching them. Provide a checked-in contact-sheet command that takes a capture directory, preserves pixels, labels the angle order, and writes a report artifact.

title: Expose bounded frame counts for lookdev timing captures
body: The native lookdev capture always used 64 frames per angle, so the 1080p timing run could take minutes and hit the queue watchdog before producing useful pass samples. I added opt-in VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_FRAMES (1–64, default still 64) and passed it through the local native runner for a 24-frame-per-angle timing capture. Consolidate this as a supported timing-only capture option while keeping visual determinism captures at their full default length.
